summary.intent: Run the full GSD pipeline for phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core): plan-phase, execute-phase, then ship-phase, all autonomously while the user is AFK.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully and verified (7 plans / 4 waves, plan-checker passed on iteration 2). Wave 1 execution was initiated but the transcript ends at the dispatch of plan 63-01 — execution and ship-phase were not completed.

repo: Phase 63 builds three subsystems: read-chain navigation walk (63-01), grant/invite crypto (63-02), and a rotation engine (63-03) that deliberately exposes 4 named seams for Phase 64.
Plans 63-01 and 63-04 share folder.test.ts, creating cross-plan coupling that makes parallel worktree execution unsafe for this phase.
The API runs on port 3000 with a /health endpoint; CI already polls it via `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` and the same bounded poll pattern should be used in test setup scripts.
commit.gpgsign was already false locally, so no 1Password biometric prompts occur during AFK runs.
The GSD commit helper consistently reports false-negatives (looks like a failure) but git log confirms commits land correctly — this is a known helper bug, not a real failure.
The stale .planning/codebase/ map triggers the drift gate but is non-blocking at plan time when CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md carry verified implementation-site references.
API surface regenerated as 0 symbols for sdk-core (backend crypto package with no exported surface detectable by the tool) — expected, not an error.

code.finding: Original plan used fragile `sleep 12` for API startup; replaced with a bounded health-poll loop mirroring the CI pattern (`curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health`).
Open Questions section required explicit `(RESOLVED)` markers on each answered question; leaving them unmarked is a plan-checker blocker even when the answers are substantively present.
VALIDATION.md must be fully populated (per-task map + nyquist_compliant: true) before the plan-checker runs; leaving it as a template skeleton triggers a warning.

workflow: Plan-checker iteration 1 returned 1 blocker + 2 warnings that were all artifact-formatting issues (not design flaws); fixing them inline and re-running the checker is the correct loop rather than re-spawning the planner.

For AFK runs with cross-plan file coupling, sequential main-tree execution is safer than parallel worktree execution — avoids node_modules bleed and api:generate race conditions documented in repo memory.
The plan-phase workflow has a false-negative pattern on the GSD commit helper that must be verified via `git log` rather than the helper's return value.
Nyquist VALIDATION.md step (5.5) only scaffolds the file during plan-phase; the per-task verification map must be filled in as a separate step after all plan files exist.

friction: GSD commit helper consistently reports false-negatives across all 6 planning commits, requiring a manual `git log` verification after every commit step.
Plan-checker required two full subagent spawns due to fixable artifact issues that could have been caught earlier (VALIDATION.md template, RESEARCH.md markers, fragile sleep).
Drift gate fired on stale codebase map and produced noise, even though it was non-blocking — no clear signal on when to refresh the map.
API surface tool returned 0 symbols for a backend crypto package, making it silently useless rather than producing an informative skip.
open_items: Wave 1 execution (63-01) was just dispatched when the transcript ends — waves 1–4 and /ship-phase 63 remain incomplete.
4 named Phase-64 seams were created in the rotation engine (plan 63-03) and must be implemented in Phase 64.
Stale .planning/codebase/ map should be refreshed before the next phase that relies on the drift gate for accurate signal.
